show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/3zVyM4
show.description: Aditi, a seemingly lucky girl, whose life is controlled by Naman Verma, a powerful and intense man who blames her family for his father’s death. What begins as a forced contract and manipulation slowly reveals hidden motives, as Naman is actually protecting Aditi from deeper dangers tied to her past and her fiancé Vikram. The story unfolds as a tense push-and-pull between hatred, control, sacrifice, and unspoken love, where truth hides behind deception and every relationship carries a shadow
